documents.text: Beacon Mill, Benenden Beacon Mill is a Grade II listed smock mill in Benenden, Kent, England which is in need of restoration. The mill has been out of use since 1923 and is privately owned. "Beacon Mill" is one of two windmills marked on the 1819-43 Ordnance Survey map. It was also marked on Greenwood's 1821 map. Towards the end of the nineteenth century, "Beacon Mill" was run in conjunction with Wandle Mill, on the River Rother.
